adam.assumes: Page views on preview deployments, including every end-to-end test run against a preview, do not count toward the 50,000 Web Analytics events a month that the account's projects share on Hobby.
adam.if_wrong: Test runs use up the quota, and Vercel stops recording production visitors without telling anyone. Fix: render Analytics only when VERCEL_ENV is production.

changed_steps.step: Tell whether this job stopped at its time limit

lesson.summary: CI run 45053642995 on pull request #651 never reached either step that pull request #648 changed, so whether those changes work is still unproven; nothing needs doing until a later run reaches them.
lesson.detail: Pull request #648 changed two steps in factory/workflows/ci.yml. It ran the end-to-end step "Playwright against the preview" as `pnpm test:e2e --workers=4`. It also made "Tell whether this job stopped at its time limit" work out the minutes with jq instead of `date -d`. Run 45053642995 checked pull request #651, which only changes a document, and it succeeded. Both changed steps were skipped. The e2e job does not run here because this repository has no app. The time-limit step runs only when the review job fails or is cancelled, and this one passed. A later run that reaches these steps will show whether the changes work.

cost.amount: Nothing: the run succeeded, and its two reviewer sessions spent $0.42 in 28 turns on their normal review of #651.

lesson.saves: Nothing: no fault was found to prevent, so there is no saving to give against the $0.42 the run spent.
